summary: Run expired; record complete. Three execution-grounded findings with retained receipts and scoped limits: RestoreCommittedLogs startup replay blocks NewRaft above 128 replay batches of the FSM channel (measured at the boundary, blocked stack retained); VerifyLeader counts nonvoter acknowledgements toward a voter quorum, outliving a competing leader in 20/20 per-node-timer trials and coinciding with committed state the confirming leader lacked in 12/12, with uniform clusters separated down to a 1ms margin; AddVoter installs a Voter immediately despite two published descriptions promising staging, stranding a single-voter cluster until the added server runs. Five suspicions refuted with evidence, one behaviour entry corrected under its own id with its affected use answered, fourteen questions answered, no gaps open.
